carrierOnboarding.title: Carrier onboarding
carrierOnboarding.subtitle: Finish setup so you can browse jobs and place bids.
carrierOnboarding.waitingOpsBody: CLOX is reviewing your documents ({{status}}). You will be notified when you can bid.
carrierOnboarding.opsRequestedInfo: CLOX asked for more info{{note}}. Re-upload only the documents they asked for, then resubmit. Other steps stay complete.
carrierOnboarding.resubmitHint: Keep existing uploads unless CLOX asked for a replacement. Re-upload only what is needed, then submit again.
carrierOnboarding.opsApprovedNotBiddingBody: Your company is approved. Complete the checklist below (payouts, truck, or drivers) to place bids.
carrierOnboarding.readyConnectPending: Set up bank payouts to receive job money
carrierOnboarding.readyFleetPending: Need at least one Active truck with RWC / COI on every required unit (prime mover + each trailer). Incomplete trucks (e.g. B-double missing Trailer 2) do not count until fixed — other ready trucks do.
carrierOnboarding.readyDriversPending: Need at least one Active driver (licence + NHVR complete and Ops-approved). Invited or pending drivers do not unlock bidding — other active drivers do.
carrierOnboarding.readyStory: Browse jobs → bid with a truck and driver → get paid your share of the accepted bid.
carrierOnboarding.readyTip: Onboarding is done — next time use Job board in the menu.
carrierOnboarding.manageFleetHint: Keep at least one truck and one driver. Add more anytime from Fleet and Drivers.
carrierOnboarding.connectUnlocksBidding: Payouts unlock receiving money after you win a bid.
carrierOnboarding.fleetUnlocksBidding: You need at least one approved truck to bid.
carrierOnboarding.driversUnlocksBidding: You need at least one driver linked to bid and run trips.
carrierOnboarding.docsRwcFleetHint: Roadworthy / Certificate of Inspection (RWC / COI) files are uploaded per registered unit on the Fleet step — not here.
carrierOnboarding.fleetRwcHint: Add each combination, then upload official RWC / COI for every required unit (prime mover and trailers) before continuing.
carrierOnboarding.fleetRwcRequired: Upload RWC / COI for every required unit on every active vehicle to continue.
carrierOnboarding.vehicleSavedRwcFailed: Vehicle saved, but RWC upload failed: {{detail}}. Upload RWC on the vehicle below, then continue.
carrierOnboarding.docsSavedHint: After Connect + fleet, use Submit step to open the Ops case with these uploads.
carrierOnboarding.connectRepairNotice: Bidding is paused until live Stripe payouts are ready. Practice/mock Connect accounts from earlier testing no longer work — complete payout setup below, then click Continue.
carrierOnboarding.connectIntro: Clox pays your transport company through a secure Stripe page (not on this Clox screen). You will enter your business details and the bank account where job money should go. This only needs to be done once.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockIntro: This environment is in practice mode. You do not open a real Stripe page. Click the first button, then click Continue so onboarding can proceed.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHint: Practice mode — no real bank details or money moves.
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeTitle: Have these ready before you start
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem1: Your Australian Business Number (ABN) — example: 51 824 753 556 (same ABN you entered on the Legal step).
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem2: Legal company name — exactly as registered (example: Acme Haulage Pty Ltd).
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem3: Business bank account in the company name — BSB and account number (example: BSB 062-000, account 1234 5678). Personal accounts may be rejected.
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem4: Business street address in Australia (example: 12 Industrial Rd, Dandenong VIC 3175).
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem5: Photo ID for a company director or authorised person — Australian driver licence or passport (Stripe may ask you to take a photo or upload it).
carrierOnboarding.connectHow1: Click “Open secure payout setup” below. A new browser tab opens on Stripe’s website.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow2: If nothing opens, your browser blocked the pop-up — use the orange “Open Stripe page again” link that appears on this screen.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow3: On Stripe: confirm your business type (usually Company), ABN, legal name, and address. Use the same details as on Clox.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow4: Add the bank account for payouts — enter BSB and account number carefully. Double-check the digits.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow5: If Stripe asks for ID or a document, upload a clear photo of the director’s licence or passport. Wait until Stripe shows the step as complete.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow6: When Stripe says you are finished (or “return to Clox”), close that tab and come back to this Clox page.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow7: Click “I’ve finished on Stripe — continue”. If Clox says payouts are not ready yet, wait a minute, finish any remaining Stripe steps, then try Continue again.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHow1: Click “Open secure payout setup” (this only marks practice payouts as started).
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHow2: You will not fill real bank details in practice mode.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHow3: Click “I’ve finished on Stripe — continue” to move to the Fleet step.
carrierOnboarding.connectTipBody: You leave Clox briefly for Stripe in this same tab. Finish bank and ID there — Stripe brings you back here automatically. Then Continue verifies payouts. Clox never asks for your full card PIN or internet-banking password.
carrierOnboarding.connectOpenedBody: If you are still on this page, open Stripe again with the button or link below. When Stripe finishes, you return here automatically.
carrierOnboarding.mockConnectReady: Practice payout setup started. Click Continue below.
carrierOnboarding.connectConfirmHint: The Continue button unlocks after you open payout setup (or when you return from Stripe).
carrierOnboarding.connectAlreadyReadyBody: Stripe payouts are confirmed for this company. Click Continue to go to Fleet.
carrierOnboarding.driversHint: Invite drivers by email. They'll receive an onboarding link.
carrierOnboarding.dgLicenceHint: Required when Dangerous goods is selected. Document or image.
carrierOnboarding.dgLicenceRequired: Upload a DG licence before enabling Dangerous goods.
carrierOnboarding.submitHint: Public liability + cargo insurance required. Re-upload only if missing.
carrierOnboarding.submitRwcFleetNote: Vehicle RWCs were collected on the Fleet step. Submit only company insurance here.
carrierOnboarding.submitSuccess: Submitted to Ops for review. We’ll update you when there’s a decision.
carrierOnboarding.errorUploadPlCargo: Please upload public liability and cargo insurance.

carrierRegister.title: Carrier registration
carrierRegister.subtitle: Create a carrier account to bid on jobs.
